name: Nocturnal Kent Superman method

card.summary: A named bundle of face and body routines, circulated by a looksmax YouTuber and forum post, that claims to produce hollow cheeks and a more masculine hormonal profile.
card.note: Claims are the author's own; no studies of the method as a whole exist.

quick.overview:
The Superman method is the name given to a set of tips attributed to the looksmax YouTuber Nocturnal Kent and described in a forum post titled as a 'revealed' method. It is presented as a multi-part plan aimed at a more sculpted face and better hormones.

The parts described in the post include rubbing ice on the inside of the cheeks for hollower cheeks and a diet and lifestyle section aimed at raising testosterone and growth hormone. No studies have tested the method as a package.
quick.how: As described by its author, the routine is a set of daily habits: cold applied to the cheek interior for a few minutes at a time, plus diet choices intended to support testosterone and growth hormone. Reported timelines come only from the post's own claims.
quick.risks: Cold applied to the skin and mucosa can cause irritation or discomfort. Researchers have not examined whether the method changes cheek fat or hormone levels, and no regulator has commented on it.

lead: The Nocturnal Kent Superman method is a lifestyle plan circulated in looksmaxxing communities and credited to the YouTuber known as Nocturnal Kent. A forum thread presenting it on looksmax.org lists several components, led by an ice-on-cheeks routine for hollow cheeks and a 'hormones' section about optimizing diet to support testosterone and growth hormone.

Its stated appearance payoff is a leaner, more sculpted midface and a more masculine look, achieved without surgery. Proponents describe the cheek-ice step as inducing vasoconstriction and fat loss in the cheek area, similar in effect to buccal fat removal.

No published study has evaluated this particular combination. Commercial cryolipolysis, a clinical fat-reduction method that uses controlled cooling, has been reviewed in the medical literature, with modest average fat-layer reductions reported, but it involves cooling devices and is not the same as rubbing ice on the mouth lining. [1]

chain: Claimed fat reduction in the cheek area
Hollower cheeks and more defined contours
angle.text: The method claims to hollow the cheeks by cooling the cheek fat and to support masculine hormones through diet. People who follow it do so hoping for a leaner, more angular face.

paras: The author of the original forum post lists numbered parts. The first is rubbing ice on the inside of the cheeks twice a day for several minutes, which the post says causes vasoconstriction and fat loss. The second, described as the most important, concerns hormones, with a diet intended to raise testosterone and growth hormone.

Proponents argue that the thin lining of the inner cheek responds strongly to cold and that this lowers cheek fat. They also point to childhood ice consumption and dimples as supporting observations. Other users in the thread joked about additional items such as jaw width and sun gazing, and about paying for the full method.

Clinical fat-freezing (cryolipolysis) works through controlled, sustained cooling by a device. Reviews of cryolipolysis report average fat-layer reductions of a few millimeters, with redness, numbness and swelling as common short-term effects and a rare complication in which treated fat enlarges. [1] None of these studies involved ice rubbed on the inner cheek.
No studies found. Cryolipolysis, a different cold-based clinical procedure, has been studied in systematic reviews. [1]

lore.intro: The method circulates on looksmax.org and video platforms as a named plan from a looksmax personality.

claims.claim: Rubbing ice inside the cheeks produces hollow cheeks like buccal fat removal
claims.believers: The forum post says ice causes vasoconstriction and speeds fat breakdown in the cheek, and treats this as a non-surgical alternative to buccal fat removal.
claims.experts: Clinical cryolipolysis studies show modest fat reduction under controlled device cooling; no study has tested ice applied to the cheek lining. [1]

claims.claim: A hormone-optimizing diet raises testosterone and growth hormone enough to change the face
claims.believers: The post calls hormones the most important part and promotes diet changes to raise them.
claims.experts: No published research has tested this plan's effect on facial appearance.
